summary:
Changes from v1: (1) REQUIRED — eta_floor is no longer pinned blind at 0.15; WP1 now MEASURES it via a tracked dense-eta scan and sets _SADDLE_ETA_FLOOR by a deterministic rule (min(0.5, measured_boundary×2)), defaulting to 0.5 so the unmeasured (0.05,0.5) band is REFUSED per the false-admit-is-a-silent-lnL-bias asymmetry; scan numbers recorded in the provenance comment and completion record; scripts/measure_saddle_eta_floor.py added to files_affected and WP1 max_turns raised to 75. (2) FACTUAL — the connecting-region follow-up is re-priced correctly (see below): the shipped npz DOES hold certified saddle rho<0.5 cells; what refuses is an API defense-in-depth guard, so the follow-up is 're-validate/relax the guard or retrain', NOT net-new training. All else unchanged.

Re-key the saddle-parity (gamma>1) far-field/ppGO admission predicate so the transverse (hard-axis) cone is served analytically instead of falling through to slow live quadrature. Root cause: the single-source-of-truth serve gate `_saddle_farfield_analytic_serves` (likelihood.py ~536-590) uses a scalar isotropic gauge `rho=|y|/caustic_reach >= _SADDLE_FARFIELD_RHO_FLOOR(2.0)` that underestimates distance to the TWO disconnected deltoid lobes, so a source far from both lobes (true nearest-caustic distance up to ~2.5) is wrongly refused. Fix: replace the rho accuracy term with a directional `eta = nearest_caustic_point(...).distance >= _SADDLE_ETA_FLOOR` term (Leg A, floor MEASURED in WP1), and make the w-resolution leg (Leg B) treat symmetry-tied mirror pairs (delta_tau<=tie_eps) as non-resolving. Serve = (A AND B). The CONNECTING region (origin->deltoid, rho<0.5, mirror pair with delta_tau==0) is NOT served this build — Leg B's mirror-pair tie refuses the symmetry axis regardless, and the certified-map path that could serve it is gated behind an API defense-in-depth guard whose relaxation deserves its own build (follow-up owed, priced correctly below). The proposed Leg C (certified w_cert) + construction-time auto-wire were TRIMMED as redundant on the in-scope rho>=1 saddle population and dormant for the connecting region. The connecting region gets a hard-assert refusal guard (correctly falls through to the exact engine). The image_count==4 deltoid-interior fence is preserved. The census mirror (surrogate_census.py) is re-gated in the same build to keep served-set == counted-set. tie_eps=1e-12 absolute, and all test tolerances/oracle carry the Professor's authority. Any SPEC.md / DATA_CONTRACTS.yaml mention of the saddle rho floor is doc-staleness for the Librarian doc-sync phase, not a WP.

work_packages.title: Re-key saddle serve gate onto directional eta (measured floor) + mirror-pair tie discipline
work_packages.what: In cogwheel/lensing/likelihood.py, re-key the single-source-of-truth saddle serve gate to serve the transverse cone via a directional nearest-caustic-distance predicate with a MEASURED accuracy floor, and to treat symmetry-tied mirror pairs as non-resolving. Retire the scalar rho accuracy term from the saddle serve path ONLY. Do NOT touch positive-parity gates, charts, _ppgo_above_ceiling, or the certified-map (_ppgo_cell_coords/_ppgo_band_split) machinery — those are out of scope and stay byte-identical.
where: cogwheel/lensing/likelihood.py: `_saddle_farfield_analytic_serves` (~536-590); the live rung `_saddle_farfield_analytic` (~2075-2160); the module constant `_SADDLE_FARFIELD_RHO_FLOOR` (~205); imports (~105-108). New tracked script scripts/measure_saddle_eta_floor.py.
work_packages.how: 0) MEASURE the eta floor before pinning it — do NOT hardcode 0.15. Write a TRACKED script `scripts/measure_saddle_eta_floor.py` that scans eta in [0.05, 1.0] at ~10 log-spaced values x gamma in {1.2, 1.5, 2.0} x the served w band (a few w-values up to 60), evaluating the analytic ppGO/FARFIELD_KERNEL_SUM serve against the saddle oracle (f_schwinger reached through the mass-sheet identity, same recipe the domain tests use). For each gamma find the worst (smallest) eta at which ppGO still clears the 1e-4 relative-|F| bar at the band max; take the max over gamma as the measured boundary. Apply this DETERMINISTIC rule (no open-ended judgement): `_SADDLE_ETA_FLOOR = min(0.5, measured_boundary * 2.0)`; if the scan cannot establish a clean boundary at or below 0.25 (so x2 would exceed 0.5) DEFAULT to 0.5 — refuse the entire unmeasured (0.05,0.5) band, because a false-admit is a silent lnL bias while a false-refuse only costs engine time (Professor asymmetry). Run the script, and paste the per-gamma boundary numbers and the chosen floor into the constant's provenance comment AND the completion record (.claude/spec/completed.d/). The transverse-cone win is preserved even at 0.5 (audited transverse points sit at eta 1.0-2.5). 1) Add module constants `_SADDLE_ETA_FLOOR = <measured value from step 0>` (with the scan provenance comment) and `_SADDLE_TIE_EPS = 1e-12` (absolute; mirrors `_airy_fold._CUSP_TIE_EPS` — a symmetry-tied mirror pair has delta_tau at the ~1e-15 machine floor, which is >0 so the current `delta_taus[delta_taus>0]` filter does NOT catch it; absolute not spread-scaled so genuinely-resolvable tight pairs are not falsely swallowed). 2) Change the serve gate to accept the directional distance instead of rho. Recommended signature `_saddle_farfield_analytic_serves(real_delays, w_lo, eta)`: Leg A term becomes `if eta is None or not np.isfinite(eta) or eta < _SADDLE_ETA_FLOOR: return False`; Leg B keeps `real = np.sort(...); delta_taus = np.diff(real)` but the surviving gaps are `delta_taus[delta_taus > _SADDLE_TIE_EPS]` (was `> 0`) — if none survive the pair is non-resolving so return False, else `return w_lo * float(np.min(surviving)) >= RHO_END`. Composition is exactly `A AND B`. 3) In the live rung `_saddle_farfield_analytic`, replace the now-dead `rho = caustic_rho(...)` computation in the saddle serve path with `eta = geometry.nearest_caustic_point(lens['gamma'], np.hypot(y1,y2), source, kappa=lens['kappa']).distance` — note `nearest_caustic_point` is invoked ONCE per band-serve (not per w-sample) and the caustic object is already on the critical path (channels.evaluate ~L1977), so this is amortized; if the ChangRefsdalChannels/geometry_partition object already exposes the nearest-caustic result, reuse it rather than recomputing. Pass eta into the serve gate. The image_count==4 deltoid-interior fence must remain: verify the existing path still refuses 4-image interiors (do not weaken it). 4) Remove the now-unused `_SADDLE_FARFIELD_RHO_FLOOR` constant and its docstring IF nothing else in the saddle serve path references it (grep first; if positive-parity code references it, leave it and only stop USING it in the saddle gate). Confirm `caustic_rho` is still needed elsewhere before removing its import. This WP touches no registered producer/consumer artifact — the certified_ppgo_map/lens_amplification_surrogate paths are explicitly NOT modified (Leg C trimmed).
work_packages.verification: _SADDLE_ETA_FLOOR is set from the recorded dense-eta scan (tracked scripts/measure_saddle_eta_floor.py), NOT a blind 0.15; its provenance comment and the completion record quote the per-gamma measured boundary and the applied floor = min(0.5, boundary*2), with the unmeasured (0.05,0.5) band refused unless the scan clears it. `_saddle_farfield_analytic_serves` gates on directional eta for accuracy and on w-resolution with symmetry-tied mirror pairs (delta_tau <= 1e-12) excluded; serve condition is A AND B. The live saddle rung computes eta from nearest_caustic_point (once per band, reusing the partition's caustic object where available) and no longer computes/consults the scalar rho floor in the saddle serve path. The image_count==4 deltoid-interior fence still refuses. Positive-parity gates, the certified-map machinery, and _ppgo_above_ceiling are byte-identical. No new certified-map install or auto-wire logic was added.

work_packages.title: Re-gate the saddle census mirror onto eta (served == counted)
work_packages.what: Update the saddle far-field census classifier in cogwheel/lensing/surrogate_census.py so it computes the SAME directional eta and calls the re-keyed serve gate with identical inputs, preserving the served-set == counted-set invariant. This is a faithful mirror of WP1's live-rung caller — same predicate, same eta computation, same tie discipline.
where: cogwheel/lensing/surrogate_census.py: the `if gamma > 1.0:` saddle-farfield mirror block (~490-530) that currently computes `rho = caustic_rho(gamma, np.hypot(y1,y2), kappa=0.0)` and calls `_saddle_farfield_analytic_serves(...)` setting `record.category = 'saddle-farfield-analytic'`.
work_packages.how: Replace the census `rho` computation with `eta = geometry.nearest_caustic_point(gamma, np.hypot(y1,y2), source, kappa=<same kappa the live rung uses>).distance` and pass `eta` into the updated `_saddle_farfield_analytic_serves(real_delays, w_lo, eta)` (new signature from WP1). Use the exact same kappa convention as the live rung (WP1) — do NOT hardcode kappa=0.0 if the live rung uses lens['kappa']; mirror the live rung faithfully. Do not introduce a second copy of eta_floor/tie_eps — import/reference the WP1 module constants so there is one authoritative value. The category label and all other census bookkeeping stay unchanged. This is census-only offline classification, so the per-draw nearest_caustic_point call cost is acceptable.
work_packages.verification: The census saddle-farfield block computes eta via nearest_caustic_point (not scalar rho) and calls the re-keyed serve gate with the same signature, kappa convention, and shared eta_floor/tie_eps constants as the live rung; census admit/refuse decisions match the live serve on every witness (served == counted). No duplicated threshold literals.

domain_test_descriptions: T1 — Transverse-cone witness is SERVED (Leg A AND B). Setup: a macro-saddle config (gamma=1.2, kappa=0) with the source on the hard-axis (transverse) cone such that nearest_caustic_point(...).distance (eta) lies in [1.0, 2.5] and the geometry yields exactly 2 real images with a resolvable non-mirror pair (w_lo * min positive delta_tau >= RHO_END=4.0). Operation: call the re-keyed serve gate (must ADMIT — this config was refused under the old rho<2.0 floor), then serve F(w) via the analytic FARFIELD_KERNEL_SUM rung and compare to the saddle oracle (f_schwinger reached through the mass-sheet identity F_{kappa,gamma}=(1/lambda)exp[iw(ln lambda/2 - kappa|y|^2/(2lambda))]F_{0,gamma/lambda}, anchored at 2-3 witness w-values against the independent 2D rotated-contour lens-plane oracle so the primary oracle is not self-referential). Expected: admitted; pointwise |F_served - F_oracle|/|F_oracle| < 1e-4 for every w in [w_lo, 60]. Diagnostic: a rel-error-vs-w curve crossing 1e-4 reveals an eta_floor set too low or a stationary-phase envelope failure near the cusp.

T2 — Connecting-region REFUSAL guard (this build does NOT serve it). Setup: a macro-saddle config (gamma>1) with the source on the origin->deltoid symmetry axis at rho<0.5 whose image pair is a symmetry-tied mirror pair (delta_tau <= tie_eps=1e-12) and image_count==2, at w>=25. Operation: call the re-keyed serve gate. Expected: it REFUSES (returns False) — Leg B excludes the tied pair as non-resolving — so the config correctly falls through to the exact engine. This is the honest current state; the test documents that the connecting region is deferred to a future build that re-validates the existing certified rho<0.5 saddle cells and relaxes the API defense-in-depth guard (or retrains). Diagnostic: if the gate ever ADMITS this config, an eta or resolution leg has been mis-composed and would emit a wrong (unserved) value.

T3 — Deltoid-lobe interior REFUSES (image_count==4 fence). Setup: a macro-saddle source placed strictly inside a deltoid lobe so the geometry yields exactly 4 real images (geom.real_mask.sum()==4), the genuine diffractive caustic interior. Operation: call the re-keyed serve gate (and, if reachable, the live rung dispatch). Expected: refuses on all legs regardless of eta or w — real-image count 4 is the exact interior discriminator and FARFIELD_KERNEL_SUM is O(1)-wrong there. Diagnostic: an admit here would inject a grossly wrong |F|; assert refusal explicitly.

T4 — Mirror-pair non-resolving has teeth (tie_eps discipline). Setup: (a) an on-axis saddle source whose only pair is symmetry-tied (delta_tau <= tie_eps) with no other resolvable positive gap -> Leg B must return False even at large w; (b) perturb the SAME source slightly off the symmetry axis so delta_tau > tie_eps and the pair becomes genuinely resolvable at the band floor -> Leg B flips to True (only the tie changes; eta held above floor and w fixed). Expected: (a) refuse, (b) admit. Diagnostic: if (a) admits, the delta_taus filter is still using `>0` instead of `> tie_eps`; if (b) refuses, tie_eps is too large and is swallowing real gaps.

T5 — eta-floor boundary bite (variable isolation). Setup: two saddle sources differing only in their nearest-caustic distance, one at eta = _SADDLE_ETA_FLOOR - epsilon and one at eta = _SADDLE_ETA_FLOOR + epsilon, both with an otherwise-resolvable non-mirror pair at a fixed w. Operation: call the serve gate on each. Expected: eta below floor REFUSES, eta above floor ADMITS — same w, same delays, only eta varies. Diagnostic: a boundary that does not bite (both admit or both refuse) means the eta term is not actually gating or the floor constant is not wired.

T6 — Single-source-of-truth: census admit/refuse == live serve. Setup: reuse the T1 (admit), T2 (refuse), T3 (refuse), and T4 (refuse/admit) witnesses. Operation: evaluate BOTH the live serve gate (likelihood.py) and the re-gated census classifier (surrogate_census.py) on each witness. Expected: identical admit/refuse verdicts on every witness (served set == counted set), using the shared eta_floor/tie_eps constants. Diagnostic: any divergence means the census mirror drifted from the live predicate (different kappa convention, duplicated threshold, or stale rho path).

PORT — Existing saddle serve-gate tests to the eta signature. The serve gate signature changes from `_saddle_farfield_analytic_serves(real_delays, w_lo, rho)` to the eta form. Port every existing test that constructs or asserts against the old 3-arg rho signature or the retired `_SADDLE_FARFIELD_RHO_FLOOR` — in test_lensing_saddle_tier1_accuracy.py, test_lensing_saddle_tier1_refusal.py, test_lensing_saddle_rho_guards.py, and test_lensing_saddle_gauge.py — to compute/pass eta and to assert against `_SADDLE_ETA_FLOOR`/`_SADDLE_TIE_EPS` instead. Preserve the intent of each ported assertion (accuracy p90, refusal boundaries) re-expressed in the eta gauge; where a test pinned a rho boundary that no longer exists, re-derive the equivalent eta boundary from live geometry (do not invent a literal). Keep the test bodies value-asserting with reachable-red self-falsification.
simplifier_inputs: TRIM Leg C (certified w_cert) + construction-time auto-wire: for rho>=1 saddle sources Leg C admits no population that Leg A AND B does not already reach, and it is dormant for the connecting region; auto-wiring the map at __init__ was also flagged as FS-side-effectful (breaks the explicit-opt-in pattern). Both removed from scope.

Leg B (mirror-pair exclusion) is LEAN — reuses the existing _CUSP_TIE_EPS discipline; but the Simplifier's note that the current `>0` filter already handles delta_tau==0 was checked and refuted: symmetry-tied pairs sit at ~1e-15 (>0), so the explicit `> tie_eps` exclusion is genuinely needed.

Keep the census re-gate a SEPARATE work package from the predicate rewrite — different file, different test surface, and the served==counted correctness constraint is independently verifiable; routed to Foreman-Lite as a faithful mechanical mirror of WP1's caller.

Simplifier proposed replacing eta with a cheaper scalar wedge-membership pre-filter to avoid a hotpath minimization; escalated to the Professor, who established the premise was wrong (see professor_inputs) — eta is kept.
professor_inputs: eta_floor is MEASURED, not pinned. Current basis: ppGO clears 1e-4 for eta>=0.5, over-bar for eta<=0.05, and (0.05,0.5) is UNMEASURED — so the conservative default is 0.5, refusing the unmeasured band because a false-admit is a silent lnL bias while a false-refuse only costs engine time. WP1 runs a dense eta scan (eta in [0.05,1.0] ~10 log-spaced x gamma in {1.2,1.5,2.0} x w<=60 vs the saddle oracle) and sets _SADDLE_ETA_FLOOR = min(0.5, measured_boundary*2.0), defaulting to 0.5 if no clean boundary is established at/below 0.25. Do NOT scale with gamma — nearest-caustic distance is already absolute. The transverse-cone win survives at 0.5 (audited transverse points sit at eta 1.0-2.5).

Composition is (A AND B) for the serve; the certified-map Leg C is trimmed. Connecting-region deferral STANDS but for the correct reason: Leg B's mirror-pair tie makes the symmetry axis refuse regardless of any map. FACTUAL: the shipped certified_ppgo_map.npz DOES hold STATUS_CERTIFIED saddle cells at rho in [0,0.5) (w_cert ~27.7/19.2/15.9 for gamma bands 1.10-1.55, independently reproduced ~16-28 for rho<=0.4); what refuses is CertifiedPpgoMap.w_cert's saddle rho<1 defense-in-depth API guard (SPEC parity-gated paragraph), NOT a missing cell. The follow-up build is therefore 're-validate the existing certified rho<0.5 saddle cells and selectively relax the API guard, or retrain' — NOT net-new offline training; relaxing a defense-in-depth guard deserves its own build, hence the deferral.

nearest_caustic_point(...) is invoked ONCE per band-serve (channels.evaluate ~L1977 / geometry_partition ~L2095), NOT per w-sample, and the caustic object is already on the critical path — so directional eta is amortized and the Simplifier's per-sample-cost premise is wrong. The wedge-membership predicate |sin 2(theta-beta)| <= (1-kappa)/|gamma| is REJECTED: it bounds the caustic's angular support (necessary, not sufficient for proximity) and would false-admit angularly-aligned but radially-distant sources — a silent lnL bias. eta (true Euclidean distance) stays.

tie_eps = 1e-12, ABSOLUTE (mirror _CUSP_TIE_EPS): symmetry-tied mirror pairs are 0 to machine precision (Fermat-potential x->-x reflection); a spread-relative tolerance would falsely swallow small-but-real resolvable gaps.

eta REPLACES rho in the accuracy leg; rho survives only as the certified-map cell coordinate — not used in this build since Leg C is trimmed. image_count==4 is the exact interior/exterior fence on both parities (no radius/rho/eta test is equivalent) and must refuse regardless of any other leg.

Oracle & bar: validate the analytic serve against f_schwinger reached through the mass-sheet identity, anchored at 2-3 witness points by the independent 2D rotated-contour lens-plane oracle (validated to ~2e-15 on saddles) so the primary oracle is not self-referential; numerical bar is 1e-4 relative on |F| across w<=60 (below the DD_PRODUCT_CEILING of 60). This same recipe drives the WP1 eta-floor measurement scan.
